project.title: [Company] — Scale Website Build
project.summary: Bespoke clinic website on the Scale package, with custom functionality, advanced AI integrations, and tailored patient journey workflows.
objectives: Bespoke, conversion-optimised clinic website with custom functionality
Advanced AI CRM with custom pipeline, fields, and automation logic
Custom AI Automations and integrations per clinic requirements
Tailored patient journey workflows and communication sequences

included: Bespoke website design and build (Scale package scope)
Custom service pages, functionality, and content structure
Advanced AI CRM setup: custom pipeline, fields, automation rules, integrations
Custom AI Automations: tailored workflows, multi-channel sequences, API integrations
Booking integration with custom CRM sync and patient journey mapping
exclusions: Content copywriting beyond the agreed page set
Ongoing changes after go-live (Web Care is separate and optional)
Third-party API costs and subscription fees
AI message credits beyond included allowance
Features not defined in the agreed scope document

timeline.notes: Bespoke scope; final schedule confirmed at agreement after discovery

vat.note: VAT status is unresolved; no tax determination is made in this proposal.

client_responsibilities: Timely feedback on content, design, CRM, and automation review stages
Required copy, imagery, detailed CRM/automation requirements before build stage
Approval of custom workflows, integrations, and message templates before activation
Access to third-party systems for integration setup
assumptions: Approved Final Project Price is the contractual commercial basis, not the public From price
No third-party costs are included without prior approval
AI message credits are subject to fair usage within included allowance
Bespoke scope requires a signed scope document before development starts
next_steps: Following acceptance, a commercial agreement and scope document are executed before invoicing
